title: Seeing What Still Holds: How Waiting Control Changes Cooperative Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.22368v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Changing the holding reference during a fixed-duration wait can reverse the ranking of visual recovery methods. We introduce AuditEmbodied, a paired execution and trajectory evaluation framework that independently varies holding references and waiting duration while keeping recovery executors frozen. A 960-execution factorial on 20 initialization seeds compares CAD-feedback and landmark-based recovery from identical post-wait physical states within each holding and waiting condition. Protected completion requires successful recovery under the declared execution constraints. At a 1 s wait with registered wrist references, their protected completion counts change from 6/40 versus 19/40 under registered holding to 34/40 versus 22/40 under position-only holding. translated_title: 看清依然持守之物：等待控制如何改变协作式恢复
translated_abstract: 在固定时长的等待期间改变持握参考，可以逆转视觉恢复方法的性能排名。我们提出 AuditEmbodied，一个成对的执行与轨迹评估框架，它在保持恢复执行器冻结的前提下，独立地变化持握参考与等待时长。一项在 20 个初始化种子上开展的 960 次执行因子实验，在每种持握与等待条件下，从完全相同的等待后物理状态出发，比较了基于 CAD 反馈的恢复与基于地标的恢复。受保护的完成要求在声明的执行约束下成功实现恢复。在 1 秒等待且使用配准腕部参考时，两种方法的受保护完成次数从配准持握下的 6/40 对 19/40，变为仅位置持握下的 34/40 对 22/40。轨迹分析将主要差异定位于抓取形成阶段：观察时刻的微小目标残差会先于大的跟踪误差出现。联合诊断与受控干预……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 AuditEmbodied 成对执行与轨迹评估框架，通过 960 次执行的因子实验证明：在固定时长等待中改变持握参考可逆转 CAD 反馈式与地标式视觉恢复方法的排名，且关键差异源于抓取形成阶段观察残差到跟踪误差的放大。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces AuditEmbodied, a paired execution-trajectory evaluation framework whose 960-execution factorial study shows that changing the holding reference during a fixed-duration wait can reverse the ranking of CAD-feedback versus landmark-based visual recovery, with the separation localized to grasp formation where small observation-time residuals precede large tracking errors.
